shared_elements: low relief carved figures on an architectural wall surface
bearded male figures with elaborate hair/beard rendering
figures wearing long garments with patterned pleats/fringes
registers or horizontal bands of figures
procession-like alignment of figures along a horizontal band
justification: Both surfaces show low-relief bearded human figures in strict profile with carefully patterned garments and hair, set on large architectural wall panels, and both include animals in profile among the figures. However, A depicts a pair of large-scale supernatural beings — a griffin-demon with multiple wings and a winged, horned-helmeted figure raising weapons in combat gesture — whereas B shows small-scale repeated files of unwinged attendants and led animals in stacked processional registers, so the relationships (confrontation of monsters vs. orderly procession) and scale/arrangement differ markedly.
